attempts.economic_attempt_definition: One self-launch plus one intended BUY. Parallel submission of byte-identical [launch_A,buy_B] bundle copies to multiple builders counts as ONE economic attempt.

bundle_bytes.max_block_window: At most send_head+2 unless a stricter provider-specific bound is available; never use a long default such as +100
bundle_bytes.expiry_mismatch: STOP if equivalent tight expiry cannot be expressed for every armed builder

fortyeightclub.rationale: N+1 qualification must not accept late-arriving bundle placement at the block tail.

bundle_bytes.send_head_rule: send_head is the next block G0.7 observes, polled over a pre-warmed keep-alive RPC TLS connection after the builder TLS prewarm, immediately before the release (not the preflight head). maxBlockNumber = send_head + 2 for both builders: this is the head+2 bound. 48Club additionally gets maxTimestamp (Unix seconds) = floor((send_head milliTimestamp + 900 ms) / 1000) + 1, milliTimestamp per BEP-520: the second after head+2's nominal second, so a 'maxTimestamp must exceed the current block time / now' check cannot refuse the bundle while head+2 is open. A seconds value cannot express head+2 exactly; maxTimestamp alone would admit blocks stamped up to that second (about head+6 at the nominal cadence), so for 48Club the head+2 bound rests on maxBlockNumber being enforced (documented as an inclusive parameter and checked by 48Club at submission per the builder probe 2026-10-16; building-time enforcement unqualified, pre-arm check 6). G0.7 stops before any bundle write if send_head is below the preflight head, has the preflight height with another hash, is older than 450 ms by the local clock or, independent of the clock, at least 450 ms staler than the endpoint's freshest read, if the local clock lags the head timestamp by more than 150 ms, if no new block arrives within 3 s, if the builder connections idled longer than 5 s, if a builder closed its prewarmed connection or sent unsolicited data, or if the journal does not hold the exact request bodies within 50 ms.

min_output.independent_cross_check: Local/offline independent sequential execution of exact launch_A then buy_B. Before authorization, exact valid Mainnet bytes MUST NOT be sent to external builder simulation endpoints.

Worst-case gas reserve 0.0004801635 BNB; total worst-case reserve 0.0004811635 BNB (launcher 0.0003301635, buyer 0.000151). The launch gas cap is the measured Mainnet eth_estimateGas 5,502,725 with a 120% reserve = 6,603,270 (re-measured at block 127865760). Validate exact native-mode launch->BUY transition independently; historical DOGE G0.3 fixture is insufficient

success.acquisition: BUY receipt success plus positive intended-token balance delta at buyer_B with attributable economic debit/cost
success.ordering: Launch and BUY are in the same canonical block; BUY transaction index equals launch transaction index + 1; zero successful external BUYs between
success.builder_evidence: Record builder submission hash/status where exposed and identify block builder/validator where reliably attributable
success.timing: N+1 is ordering evidence only. T_buy-T0 remains UNKNOWN unless an original producer witness conforming to producer_execution_witness_v1 exists; re-execution traces never qualify. For attempt 1 the producer witness source is not available (source_ready=false), so the timing gate cannot pass for this attempt.

on_expiry_without_inclusion: Verify neither transaction appeared canonically or in the public mempool where observable
retention_observability.interpretation: Inclusion one or two blocks after submission is evidence relevant to bundle carry/re-simulation, but provider retention semantics must not be assumed solely from one successful inclusion.
retention_observability.g07_local_attempt_state: G0.7 runs only from the main checkout and creates bsc/.local/g07/<attempt_id>/ (0700, git-ignored, no symlinks) with ATTEMPT_LATCH and capture.journal (0600) before the guard; a second start of the same attempt_id is refused while that directory exists. The journal holds broadcastable signed bytes: never commit or share it before both nonces are consumed on-chain. A run that provably wrote no bundle byte (guard refusal or pre-egress stop, journal AUTHORIZATION_REFUSED or PRE_EGRESS_ABORT) is not an economic attempt: G0.7 renames the directory to <attempt_id>.refused-<ms> or .pre-egress-<ms> (journal kept) and removes its own empty evidence file, so the same attempt can be started again by the user's explicit decision. Right after the release G0.7 writes RELEASED into the directory; from then on the latch is never released and the attempt is consumed whatever the outcome. DARKBOT_G07_EVIDENCE_PATH is mandatory, must not exist and must lie in a private directory (real directory, no symlink on the way, mode 0700, owned by the user, e.g. bsc/.local/g07/); the evidence file is 0600 and only ever replaced atomically (complete fsynced private sibling, rename, directory sync), never truncated in place: provisional right after the release, again after the send threads, final after the receipt window; each write is first checked against the fields G0.8 reads. G0.7 never marks the canonical [T0, T0+15 s] window as reconciled; that is G0.8's job.

thresholds.PASS: Controlled self-launch attempt acquires the token and produces same-block adjacent [launch_A@N,buy_B@N+1] ordering with zero successful external BUYs between, no public leakage, no budget/scope violation and complete evidence
thresholds.ADAPT: Bundle valid but not adjacent/same-block, builder rejected/outbid/expired, dry simulation divergence, or incomplete attribution without a safety violation
thresholds.STOP: Any scope/version mismatch, non-distinct wallets, zero/unverified minOutput, fee/floor uncertainty at arming, budget violation, nonce conflict, unexpected public broadcast, first revert, unresolved sent transaction, unexpected duplicate economic execution, or inability to prove expiration/non-execution safely

A local/offline independent sequential execution of launch_A followed by buy_B succeeds, produces the same token address and exact received token amount as the local economics calculation, and signed minOutput is >0 and <= independently simulated received amount. Historical DOGE fixture values are not reused as authority.

Current acceptance/ranking gas-floor semantics for every armed builder are independently verified before signing; identical signed bytes satisfy the strictest verified requirement. Independent simulated gas for launch and BUY, multiplied by the signed gas price and combined with launch value, BUY value and any allowed builder cost, fits both the per-attempt reserve and absolute approved budget.

Bundle expiry/maxBlock fields are within the approved tight window, launcher and buyer pending nonces match the signed transactions, and an egress guard proves zero bytes of the valid signed launch, valid signed BUY, or valid bundle payload were written to any socket/process/stdout/file intended for network transmission before authorization.
